pages.text: e^(iπ) + 1 = 0. Five constants, each made in its own phase: $(item)Zero$() and $(item)Unity$() (Foundations), the $(item)π Crystal$() (the Geometer's Table), the $(item)e Crystal$() and the $(item)Imaginary Unit$() (the Integrator).
On the Formal Proof Assistant, e, i and π prove the $(item)Half Turn$(): e^(iπ) = −1, half a turn round the unit circle. The Half Turn, Unity and Zero then prove $(item)Euler's Identity$().

It is an abstract catalyst: it never wears. With it the Concept Compressor makes a Mathematics Singularity from half of everything (and half the fluids, and none of the chronons, Hawking radiation or solvent), and the Proof Assistant makes a Riemann Zeta Crystal from 16 Prime Shards, 2 Complex Planes and a π Crystal.
